{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black long-sleeve blouse with a relaxed fit and subtle sheer panels in navy blue fabric (#0a0f1e)
High-waisted straight-leg trousers in dark denim with a slight stretch in charcoal grey cotton blend (#36454f)
Chunky black leather ankle boots with a low block heel in matte finish (#111111)
This outfit is perfect for a rock concert on a Friday night because it balances edge and comfort while keeping her warm during autumn evenings inside the club. The dark color palette complements her natural tones, allowing the venue's artificial lighting to make the sheer details of the blouse stand out. The loose cut and sturdy boots ensure she can walk freely throughout the event without feeling restricted by the energetic atmosphere."}
